title: Texas appeals court overturns divorce decree issued without a final hearing, orders a new trial
summary_full: A Texas appeals court has recently ruled in favor of a father, overturning his divorce decree due to procedural missteps. It was found that his ex-wife failed to provide substantial evidence to back her claims. Kevin Painter, Sr. had spent six years abroad with their child while his ex-wife had returned to the United States.
